data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'kerkos' which means a spear, rod, or staff. In Christian tradition, the name Kerk symbolizes a spiritual foundation or community, represented by a church or temple. The name Kerk carries the meaning “Church, Temple” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kerk usually hope their child will grow to embody church, temple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
